reasoning: This is a diagnostic data collection tool (must-gather) for Red Hat OpenShift AI. It is packaged as a container image built on top of the OpenShift origin-must-gather base image, and contains a suite of bash shell scripts (in collection-scripts/) that collect logs, Kubernetes resources, CRDs, and configuration from RHOAI component namespaces on OpenShift and non-OpenShift Kubernetes clusters (AKS, EKS, CKS). It is invoked via 'oc adm must-gather' or as a Kubernetes Job.
